package.name: base_keys
package.description: Airseekers Tron top-panel button driver (evdev "key input" device) — publishes mower_interfaces/MowerBaseButtonInfo on /mower_base/button_info and the key_pressed bitmask on /mower_base/key_pressed, and maps keys to actions (/clear_estop, HighLevelControl START/STOP/HOME).
